entries.name: Battery
entries.desc: Fresh cells for the flashlight. Swapping makes a small click.

entries.name: Matches
entries.desc: Relights a dead lamp, lights candles, or gives a brief flare.

entries.name: Lamp Oil
entries.desc: Refills the lamp. Also the price of a Lantern Ward.

entries.name: Bandage
entries.desc: Closes one wound. Takes a few quiet seconds.

entries.name: Clean Cloth
entries.desc: Two pieces make a bandage.

entries.name: Tin Can
entries.desc: Throw it for a clatter. Add nails for something louder.

entries.name: Loose Nails
entries.desc: Rattles nicely inside a tin.

entries.name: Rattle Tin
entries.desc: A tin full of nails. Lands loud: lures anything that listens.

entries.name: Glass Bottle
entries.desc: Shatters on landing. Very loud, very once.

entries.name: Coin
entries.desc: A quiet little distraction for nearby ears.

entries.name: Lens Shard
entries.desc: A sliver of the broken Lens. It still remembers being a lamp.

entries.name: Lantern Ward
entries.desc: Placed light that holds the dark at bay for a short while. Its hum carries.

entries.name: Brass Key
entries.desc: Heavy brass. Warm from a pocket.

entries.name: Bone Key
entries.desc: Carved, not cast.

entries.name: Iron Key
entries.desc: Cold even in the lamp.

entries.name: Cellar Key
entries.desc: Teal with verdigris. It opens the way down.

entries.name: Fuse
entries.desc: A ceramic fuse. The generator is hungry for two.

entries.name: Gate Crank
entries.desc: The handle for the cellar gate winch.

entries.name: Gate Wheel
entries.desc: A heavy iron wheel. The winch is missing it.

entries.name: The Stopped Clock
entries.desc: It stopped when the last lamp went out. It would like to start again.

entries.name: Boiler Key
entries.desc: Cold even in the lamp.

entries.name: Cellar Latch Key
entries.desc: Cold even in the lamp.
